final: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS status, s.pulsepersec AS rate FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry), status_avg AS (SELECT status, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM matched GROUP BY status), overall1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS o1 FROM status_avg), kept1 AS (SELECT sa.status, sa.avg_rate, sa.avg_rate - o.o1 AS diff1 FROM status_avg sa JOIN overall1 o ON o.o1 IS NOT NULL WHERE sa.avg_rate > o.o1), overall2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS o2 FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.status, k.avg_rate, k.diff1, k.avg_rate - o.o2 AS diff2 FROM kept1 k JOIN overall2 o ON o.o2 IS NOT NULL WHERE k.avg_rate > o.o2) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_of_status_avgs, AVG(diff1) AS avg_diff_first, AVG(diff2) AS avg_diff_second FROM kept2
